sections.name: EmbeddingService
sections.title: Turning text into number lists
sections.what: Converts text into a list of numbers (an embedding) that captures its meaning, so similar texts get similar numbers. It only works with the OpenAI provider and raises an error for any other provider. A single shared instance is created when the file loads, so the rest of the app uses the same settings.
sections.why: Retrieval needs embeddings to measure how close a question is to stored document pieces. The shared instance avoids rebuilding the settings on every call.
sections.watch_out: The OpenAI calls here use a module-level style that the current OpenAI library may not provide, so this path has likely not been run and may fail on first use.
